questions.prompt: A lab shows ⏭ in lab status. You go back, do the work, and pass its check. Its mark becomes…

options.a: ✓ — a pass always upgrades the mark
options.b: ▶ — in progress until the next lab passes
options.c: ⏭ — skipped is permanent; it never becomes ✓

questions.prompt: Which command replays your last recap card?
Why must an answer line be exactly q1=b, never Q1 = b?

options.a: style preference — the grader normalizes case and spacing
options.b: check.sh greps the anchored pattern ^q1=b$ — any other spelling doesn't match and the check fails
options.c: the CLI rewrites the file before grading
